digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate T13 trigger lexicon and criterion routing
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on new prohibitions (forbidden actions) but should also fire when a plan adds a new obligation (contract, invariant, schema field, required argument, or multi-site sync requirement) that existing code now owes

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py lacks alternation branch for additive-obligation phrasings, leaving compliant plans unreachable despite matching the T13 router's stated applicability

Historical commit analysis over 40 recent CLI-surface changes shows ~10% genuine MCP/NDJSON parameter-parity debt that was missed; this debt is now covered deterministically by the write_parity_contract oracle, making a new LLM criterion redundant

The recommended content-triggered surface-parity criterion widening would fire on ~70% of CLI changes that owe nothing (parser refactors, bridge-only commands, UX-only guards), matching the ~90%-none false-positive rate of the omitted-scope-site class

P2 (T13 lexicon widen) is approved as minimal-value prompt edit; P0 (deterministic import-walk in CI) replaces the LLM import-integrity criterion; P1 (FP assessment) rejects content-triggered widening; P3 and ci-gate-compat are rejected per operator ruling
